item.title: ON THE MOVE: James Williams to build winning brand at new Tomball West
item.description: James Williams has been a major force in the Greater Houston high school football landscape for more than a decade. During his tenure at Fort Bend Marshall, Williams built the Buffalos into a dominant Class 5A powerhouse, advancing to the State Finals twice and establishing one of the most respected brands in Texas high school football. item.title: DREAM TEAM: VYPE’s Malatesta, H-Town HSS' Freed dive into last 20 years of Houston high school sports
item.description: VYPE’s Matt Malatesta and H-Town High School Sports’ Todd Freed take a deep dive into the last 20 years of Greater Houston high school sports.From Sam McGuffie’s leap heard around the world to North Shore’s unforgettable Hail Mary touchdown to win a state championship, Freed and Malatesta have truly seen it all.Tune in as the duo reflects on the greatest teams, players, coaches, and moments that defined two unforgettable decades of Houston-area sports.Listen in.
